prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Companion"]
1: ["Sign in with your original account to keep your saved pets across desktop sessions.", "Using your main account ensures your pet progress is never reset."]
2: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are preparing your desktop pet. You can minimize this window while you wait."]
3: ["Learn Desktop Controls", "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click the pet anytime to open the menu to hide, feed, or chat.", "Start Playing"]
4: ["Preview Your Custom Companion", "Here is a preview of how custom companions look on your desktop background.", "Upload Photos Next"]
5: ["Choose Your Adoption Path", "Pick a quick starter pet or create a unique custom companion from scratch."]
6: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Right-click the pet at any time to open settings or hide it."]
7: ["Save Your Companion to Account", "Sign in now to save your customized pet so it stays available across sessions."]
8: ["Background Generation Active"]
9: ["Upload front-facing, well-lit photos for the cleanest desktop pet render.", "Best Results Tip"]
